## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Change type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Maintenance / refactor

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Relevant lint, type and security checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples are updated.
- [ ] No secrets or customer-sensitive data are included.
- [ ] Tenant isolation, authorization and approval boundaries remain enforced.
- [ ] Operational, migration and rollback implications are documented.

## Evidence

List commands, workflow links, screenshots or other reproducible evidence.

## Risk and rollout

Describe compatibility impact, data migrations, deployment requirements and rollback plan. Write `None` when not applicable.
